scope: evidence-backed BLE handshake reconstruction (R2). Packet/state machinery is source-backed; cryptographic inputs are account-issued and absent here, so no bind is (or can be) produced. Outcome B: machinery without authentication semantics.

sequence.driver: q.n(): logs 'RSA-开始第一次握手', stage tag 'pre_handshake'
sequence.request_ctor: (chunk_index: int, chunk_count: int, chunk: bytes, force_clear: bool)
sequence.marker: 0xFE10 normal, 0xFE20 force-clear (v4.getBleRequestType returns 0xFE20 iff flag d else 0xFE10; bytecode-verified)
sequence.frame_evidence: v4.enPkg bytecode: merge[a(marker)->2B-LE, c(count)->1B, c(index)->1B, chunk]; ALLOC widths verified in TntBleCommUtils bodies (a(I)=2B, c(I)=1B). Corrects the earlier u24-count assumption.
sequence.payload: Base64-decoded SN signature (z-store 'snSignature', missing aborts 'sn_signature_empty'), chunked (len+99)//100, 100 B slices via Arrays.copyOfRange
sequence.payload_provenance: SN signature is server-issued (partner sn-sign endpoint); device SN comes from physical scan. NEITHER exists here: emulator can frame synthetic bytes only.
sequence.response: marker 0xFE11 (proceed to sendRSAPublic) or 0xFE12 (encrypted secret package)
sequence.ble: 2BB1 write; response on 2BB0 via the same z.a/z$c path as control frames

sequence.reassembly: 0xFE12 chunks collected in z.G list and concatenated (onCharacteristicChanged ~387-444)
sequence.decrypt: q5.a(userRSAPrivateKey_PEM, reassembled); null aborts; length < 56 aborts 'RSA decrypt result too short, abort handshake'
sequence.split: J=[0:32] ChaCha20 key, K=[32:44] 12B nonce, L=[44:56] 12B associated data (copyOfRange bounds from raw bytecode: 32, 32/44, 44/56)
sequence.self_check: q5.b(J,K,L,dec[56:]) must UTF-8 decode to 'PLAUD.AI', else 'ChaCha20 decrypt result invalid, skip'
sequence.dispatch: z.e(65042) marker lookup -> registered s$b callback
sequence.key_provenance: userRSAPrivateKey PEM from the z-store, originating in the server gen-key response; userRSAPublicKey (same origin) is what w4 uploads. Phone generates nothing (no KeyPairGenerator in the AAR).

sequence.driver: q.a0(): stage tag 'send_rsa_public'; aborts 'user_rsa_public_key_empty' when unset
sequence.frame: [01][0xFE12 u16le][count u8][index u8][chunk ≤100B] (w4.getBleRequestType()=65042, same enPkg shape as v4)
sequence.response: per-chunk callbacks; completion advances to firstHandshake

sequence.driver: q.a(): logs 'handshake start', registers opcodes {1, 2} ('HandShakeReq:one--sendFail' on send failure)
sequence.request_ctor: (int, int, token: String, port_version: int); j3 extends k3 with user strings e/f
sequence.token_provenance: q.g String, account-issued device token (server-side; 'deviceToken'/'serToken' family). UNAVAILABLE here.
sequence.token_padding: 16 vs 32 bytes by port version (jadx-era extraction; port<3 comparison verified in k3.enPkg but byte-exact cutover unreverified: STRONGLY INFERRED)
sequence.k3_layout_status: NOT byte-exact: obfuscated shuffle body not fully decoded, and no legitimate token exists to test against. k3/j3 request building is NOT implemented.
sequence.response_dispatch: q.a([B): reads type word, logs 'handshake data type'; type==1 -> 'old HandShakeRsp' (new l3); type==2 -> 'handshake_get_ssn' (new x2, log 'getSsnRsp ssn:', store via q.b, then q.d0()); else 'HandShakeReq:fail-callbackType:' + 'callback_type_error_'
sequence.note: Dispatch is on the response TYPE word, not bare opcode: l3(1)/x2(2) duality resolved by outstanding-request context.

sequence.driver: q.d0(): builds j3 (k3 base + user field)
sequence.response: l3; status==0 records capabilities (portVersion, timezone, wifi/audio flags) and advances toward syncTime
sequence.j3_extension_status: k3-base + user strings with u8 length prefixes (c(I) widths verified); exact 8-byte-field semantics partially recovered: HYPOTHESIS, not implemented

sequence.implementation: no separate request: the SSN arrives as the type-2 response to firstHandshake; q.a parses x2, stores ssn, calls q.d0()
sequence.x2_layout: GetSsnRsp{ssn, versionName}: ASCII from offset 3 to first NUL (28-zero default when absent; constant length verified from the class constant pool), versionName = trailing bytes
sequence.ssn_provenance: device-issued per handshake; unavailable without hardware

sequence.event: listener.bleBind(sn: String, status: Int, protVersion: Int, timezone: Int); only status==0 accepted (both templates)
sequence.internal_trigger: not located in the AAR (bridged to the app layer); bound to the l3.status==0 completion path by lifecycle evidence
sequence.emulator_status: UNREACHABLE by design. No bypass exists; tests assert bare exchanges never enter BOUND.

l3_opcode_1.layout: u8 status@3, u16 portVersion@4, u8 timezone@6, u8 timezoneMin@7, u8 audioChannel@8, bool supportWifi@9, bool noNsAgc@10, bool isOggAudio@11, char versionType@(len-4), u24BE version@last-3
l3_opcode_1.name_mapping: toString literal order: status<-b, portVersion<-c, timezone<-d, timezoneMin<-e, audioChannel<-f, supportWifi<-g, noNsAgc<-h, isOggAudio<-i, versionType<-j, version<-k; first toString getfield targets a superclass/scratch slot, remaining ten map in order
l3_opcode_1.minimum: progressive (audit 2026-09-22, raw guard bytes): b/c/d unguarded (parser needs len>=7); e needs 8, f 9, g 10, h 11, i 12; j/k tail whenever len>=12 (reaching tail code requires passing the len<12 guard). min_length 8 = first guarded field.

crypto_boundary.rsa_keygen: server-side: POST /developer/api/open/partner/sdk/gen-key -> {private_key, public_key}. No KeyPairGenerator anywhere in the 674-class AAR: the phone CANNOT mint keys.
crypto_boundary.phone_holds: user RSA private key PEM (q5 parses PKCS8) to RSA-decrypt the 0xFE12 secret; uploads user public key via w4
crypto_boundary.device_holds: its own key material (opaque to us); encrypts the ChaCha session package with the user public key
crypto_boundary.sn_signature: server-side: POST .../sn-sign {sn} -> {signature}; phone Base64-decodes into v4 chunks. SN itself comes from physical scan.
crypto_boundary.session_crypto: ChaCha20-Poly1305 (q5, Conscrypt fallback) under per-handshake J/K/L; AES/GCM also present in q5 (unused by this path per evidence)
crypto_boundary.post_bind_envelope: once J/K/L are set, z$c ChaCha-decrypts EVERY 2BB0 notification (q5.b(J,K,L,value); invalid -> 'ChaCha20 decrypt result invalid, skip'). R1a-R1c therefore reconstruct the INNER PLAINTEXT layer (what parsers consume post-decrypt); our emulator speaks that layer, not the wire ciphertext. No app-layer control-frame reassembly exists.
crypto_boundary.deterministic_in_emulator: framing arithmetic, marker dispatch, parser offsets, guard thresholds, state order. Everything else (keys, signature, SN, token, session params, ciphertext) requires account credentials and/or hardware.
crypto_boundary.fabrication_line: no credentials, signatures, tokens, or ciphertexts are synthesized anywhere in emulator/ or tests; R2 vectors are framing/parser structure with synthetic payload bytes, never presented as authentic material

A_directly_observed: partner endpoint paths + GenKey/SnSign model fields
RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding + PKCS8 PEM parsing in q5
J/K/L split bounds (raw copyOfRange args 0/32/44/56) + min-56 + PLAUD.AI self-check in z$c
MTU-255 request on connect + single-getValue consumption, no accumulation buffers
z7 has no static constructor call-site (full-AAR scan)
B_source_derived_incomplete: ChaCha session use for post-bind traffic (path exists when J/K/L set; pre-key frames take other branches)
phone holds user private key (PEM parsed from z-store string; store-write path not fully traced)
token = q.g deviceToken family (issuance call unmapped)
snSignature via sn-sign (models seen; template call noted, not bytecode-traced)
